mods.description: Waypoint mod for @DillonB07 on Replit.com - Created by @AwMan3703

releases.notes:
## Base version
### Contains the base features:
- [x] /waypoint create command
- [x] /waypoint delete command
- [x] /waypoint list command
- [x] /waypoint info command
- [x] /waypoint follow command, with relative HUD datapack

> [!NOTE]
> **Download both the mod and the .zip archive!** `FW_Datapack.zip` should be unpacked in your server's `datapack/` directory, as the datapack is needed for the `/waypoint follow` command to display the HUD

## Full version
### Contains all features:
- [x] /waypoint create command
- [x] /waypoint delete command
- [x] /waypoint bookmark command
- [x] /waypoint list command
- [x] /waypoint info command
- [x] /waypoint follow command, with relative HUD datapack
- [x] Polished chat UI, with onHover and onClick states to simplify user experience
